verdict.rationale: Square's official MCP server (remote OAuth or local, with a Sandbox mode) exposes a generic `make_api_request` tool over a service catalog that includes catalog and checkout. That plausibly lets an agent create a catalog item and then a checkout link in one session, and Catalog API object handling is documented. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents creating a priced item variation or a payment link. Nor is there any example or hands-on report of chaining these steps end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit payment-link creation docs (Checkout API), documented price/item-variation provisioning, an end-to-end agent walkthrough or hands-on corroboration of the product→price→link flow.
